text: ArcaCore finds an app's config file in its config folder or its bundle, reads it as YAML with every scalar as written, refuses what it cannot read in one line naming the file, the key and the value, and expands {token} templates, naming any token left without a value. ArcaMasthead turns Markdown into HTML through cmark-gfm with GitHub's tables, strikethrough, autolinks and task lists, passing HTML through.
